title: NarratorPolicyCfg
description: The narrator-framing policy — loadable form of [`super::config::NarratorPolicy`].

direct_address.description: The disposition a direct-audience-address plan earns.

mode_rules.description: Per-mode dispositions; modes absent here are [`Disposition::Allowed`].

Disposition.description: What a narrator-framing choice earns: an error, a warning, or nothing.

oneOf.description: The framing is forbidden — an error finding.
The framing is discouraged — a warn finding.
The framing is permitted — no finding.

NarratorMode.description: The narrator framing of an audio packet.

oneOf.description: A windowpane narrator — transparent orientation, no personality.
A tale-host narrator (a host-narrator ban is world policy).

NarratorModeRuleCfg.description:
The disposition a single narrator mode earns — loadable form of
[`super::config::NarratorModeRule`] (design §3 item 5).

mode.description: The narrator mode this rule governs.
